run_autoround_quantize_and_save: run AutoRound to quantize a model with specified bits, group_size, and symmetry then save it
test_autoround_tritonv2_2bits_asym: test AutoRound 2-bit asymmetric quantization with tritonv2 backend on a causal language model
test_autoround_tritonv2_4bits_sym: test AutoRound 4-bit symmetric quantization with tritonv2 backend and evaluate accuracy on float16 and bfloat16
create_autoround_config_tritonv2: create an AutoRoundConfig with tritonv2 backend to load a quantized model from a saved path
review_test_autoround_triton_backend: review the TestAutoRoundTritonBackend test class that validates quantization accuracy across multiple bit widths and symmetry settings
